findings.motion: HB 1264 'Election security', Senate third reading, Roll Call 222, passed 34-13
findings.note: Official Senate roll call (mirror of the General Assembly file) lists Carrasco among the 34 Yea votes. The enrolled bill adds a proof-of-residence step for some new voters (photo ID or a utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck or government document), and a check of voter rolls against BMV temporary-credential lists, with a 30-day window to prove citizenship by birth certificate, passport or naturalization papers.

findings.motion: HEA 1264 enrolled text, new IC 3-7-38.2-7.3 (proof of citizenship) and IC 3-7-33-4.7 (proof of residence)
findings.note: Text of the act she voted for. Under IC 3-7-38.2-7.3(c) a registered voter flagged as possibly not a citizen must give proof of citizenship to the county voter registration office within thirty days, and under (d) the office cancels the registration if none is given; (e) allows an appeal. For voters who must show extra identification at the polls the bill lists a current photo ID, utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck or government document showing name and address.
subjects: photo ID at the polls (non-photo documents accepted for residence)
